formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point), ((Triangle) ∧ (formTriangle a b c AB BC AC) ∧ (formTriangle d b c DB DC BC) ∧ (¬(Line.intersectsLine AB DC)) ∧ (¬(Line.intersectsLine AD BC)) ∧ ((Line.intersectsCircle AB (Circle.mk BC (|(a─d)|)))) ∧ ((Line.intersectsCircle AD (Circle.mk BC (|(a─d)|))))) → ((Triangle.area △ a:b:c = Triangle.area △ d:b:c))
formalizations.full_output: theorem triangles_on_same_base_between_same_parallels_are_equal (a b c d : Point) (ABC DBC : Triangle) (h1 : formTriangle a b c AB BC AC) (h2 : formTriangle d b c DB DC BC) (h3 : ¬(Line.intersectsLine AB DC)) (h4 : ¬(Line.intersectsLine AD BC)) (h5 : (Line.intersectsCircle AB (Circle.mk BC (|(a─d)|)))) (h6 : (Line.intersectsCircle AD (Circle.mk BC (|(a─d)|)))) : (Triangle.area △ a:b:c = Triangle.area △ d:b:c) := by

formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point) (AD : Line) (BC : Line), ((distinctPointsOnLine a d AD) ∧ (distinctPointsOnLine b c BC) ∧ (¬(AD.intersectsLine BC)) ∧ (¬(AD.intersectsLine BC)) ∧ (a ≠ b) ∧ (c ≠ d)) → (Triangle.congruent (Triangle.ofPoints a b c) (Triangle.ofPoints d b c))

nl_statement: Triangles which are on the same base and between the same parallels are equal to one another.  Let $ABC$ and $DBC$ be triangles on the same base $BC$, and between the same parallels $AD$ and $BC$. I say that triangle $ABC$ is equal to triangle $DBC$. <prf> Thus, triangle $ABC$ is equal to triangle $DBC$.Thus, triangles which are on the same base and between the same parallels are equal to one another.
